title: Forms Introduction
description: Forms are interactive elements that allow websites to collect information from users.
They are commonly used for registration pages, login systems, surveys, feedback forms, and contact pages.
The <form> tag acts as a container for form controls such as text fields, buttons, checkboxes, and dropdown menus.
Forms play an important role in web applications because they enable communication between users and websites.

example.output: A textbox where users can type their name.
